rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a person who teaches.

example.english: That was my favorite teacher when I was little.
example.traditional: 我細個最鍾意嗰位老師。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 go2 wai2 lou5 si1

rows.note: Use this more formal term especially for someone employed as a schoolteacher or in official contexts.

example.english: The Education Bureau announced that it will hire an additional teacher next school year.
example.traditional: 教育局宣布下學年會增聘一名教師。
example.jyutping: gaau3 juk6 guk6 syun1 bou3 haa6 hok6 nin4 wui5 zang1 ping3 jat1 ming4 gaau3 si1

rows.note: Use this mainly as a respectful or traditional form of address for a male teacher, rather than the default word.

example.english: Teacher, could I ask one more time?
example.traditional: 先生，我可唔可以問多次呀？
example.jyutping: sin1 saang1 ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 man6 do1 ci3 aa3
